newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield up 10 bps to 2.610 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield up 10 bps to 2.610 pct.

text.p: The yield of the key 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) rose to 2.610 percent in early Tokyo on Friday, up 10 basis points from Thursday's finish.
The yield was the highest since January 7, when the key 182nd bond yield rose as high as 2.630 percent.
Selling mounted from the start of Friday's session amid an ongoing downtrend.

Market sentiment was further dampened by the dollar's sharp fall against the yen, triggered by a senior MOF official's remark after the Tokyo close on Thursday that the yen could strengthen to 103 yen to the dollar. Traders said the remark fuelled fears of higher Japanese interest rates.

Traders said the sellers on Friday morning were mainly dealers. Investors were hesitant to sell cash JGBs, as their sales would cause further losses after the recent decline of more than two yen in long-term JGB prices.
